---
title: "gridmetrics raster input versus terra"
format: html
---

Times `gridmetrics` on a height raster against `terra` doing equivalent
work in R, on a synthetic canopy height model written once to the work
folder. Not rendered; run the chunks in order.

```{r, setup, eval=T}

    # 1. settings
        dir_work = "D:/FUSION2_build/benchmark_terra"
        exe_gridmetrics = "D:/FUSION2_build/build_pipeline_raster/gridmetrics.exe"
        n_pixel_side = 8000
        cell_pixels = 30
        min_height = 2
        n_threads_tiled = 8

    # 2. create the work folder
        dir.create(dir_work, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

    # Validation 2 (STOP). confirm the executable exists
        if(!file.exists(exe_gridmetrics)){
            stop("gridmetrics.exe was not found.")
        }

```

## Create the canopy height model

A smooth, tree-like surface with 15% bare ground and a few missing blocks,
written as one GeoTIFF with 1 m pixels.

```{r, make_chm, eval=T}

    # 1. build the raster description
        path_chm = file.path(dir_work, "chm_synthetic.tif")
        rast_chm = terra::rast(
            nrows = n_pixel_side
            , ncols = n_pixel_side
            , xmin = 500000
            , xmax = 500000 + n_pixel_side
            , ymin = 5000000
            , ymax = 5000000 + n_pixel_side
            , crs = "EPSG:32610"
        )

    # 2. fill with heights, only when the file does not exist yet
        if(!file.exists(path_chm)){

            # A. column and row positions of every pixel
            col_index = rep(1:n_pixel_side, times = n_pixel_side)
            row_index = rep(1:n_pixel_side, each = n_pixel_side)

            # B. crown-like heights between 0 and 40
            heights = 20 + 12 * sin(col_index / 17) * cos(row_index / 23) + 8 * sin((col_index + row_index) / 41)
            heights = pmax(heights, 0)

            # C. bare ground in 15% of pixels, and missing blocks
            set.seed(1)
            is_bare = runif(length(heights)) < 0.15
            heights[is_bare] = 0
            heights[col_index > 1000 & col_index < 1400 & row_index > 2000 & row_index < 2400] = NA

            # D. write the raster
            terra::values(rast_chm) = heights
            terra::writeRaster(rast_chm, path_chm, datatype = "FLT4S", gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW", "TILED=YES"), overwrite = TRUE)
            rm(heights, col_index, row_index, is_bare)
            gc()
        }

    # Validation 2 (STOP). confirm the raster is on disk
        if(!file.exists(path_chm)){
            stop("The synthetic raster was not written.")
        }

```

## Time terra

`terra::aggregate()` with built-in functions, then with one custom R
function that returns the same statistics gridmetrics reports: mean, three
percentiles, maximum, and cover.

```{r, time_terra, eval=T}

    # 1. read the raster as terra would for a normal workflow
        rast_in = terra::rast(path_chm)

    # 2. built-in functions: mean and max of every 30 x 30 pixel cell
        time_terra_mean = system.time({
            rast_mean = terra::aggregate(rast_in, fact = cell_pixels, fun = "mean", na.rm = TRUE)
        })
        time_terra_max = system.time({
            rast_max = terra::aggregate(rast_in, fact = cell_pixels, fun = "max", na.rm = TRUE)
        })

    # 3. one custom function giving six statistics per cell
        fn_cell_stats = function(x){
            x = x[!is.na(x)]
            x_canopy = x[x >= min_height]
            if(length(x_canopy) == 0){
                return(c(NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, 100 * 0))
            }
            q = quantile(x_canopy, c(0.25, 0.5, 0.95), names = FALSE)
            c(mean(x_canopy), q[1], q[2], q[3], max(x_canopy), 100 * length(x_canopy) / length(x))
        }
        time_terra_custom = system.time({
            rast_custom = terra::aggregate(rast_in, fact = cell_pixels, fun = fn_cell_stats)
        })

```

## Time gridmetrics

Whole raster in one run, then tiled with 1 and several threads. Each run
produces all of gridmetrics' bands, not only the six terra computed.

```{r, time_gridmetrics, eval=T}

    # 1. helper that runs gridmetrics and returns its elapsed seconds
        fn_run_gridmetrics = function(args){
            seconds = system.time({
                status = system2(exe_gridmetrics, args, stdout = FALSE, stderr = FALSE)
            })[["elapsed"]]
            if(status != 0){
                stop("gridmetrics failed: ", paste(args, collapse = " "))
            }
            seconds
        }
        common_args = c(
            paste0("/cellsize:", cell_pixels)
            , paste0("/minht:", min_height)
        )

    # 2. whole raster in one run
        dir_out_whole = file.path(dir_work, "out_whole")
        seconds_whole = fn_run_gridmetrics(c(path_chm, common_args, paste0("/outdir:", dir_out_whole)))

    # 3. tiled, one thread
        dir_out_tiled_1 = file.path(dir_work, "out_tiled_1")
        seconds_tiled_1 = fn_run_gridmetrics(c(path_chm, common_args, "/tilesize:2400,2400", "/threads:1", paste0("/outdir:", dir_out_tiled_1)))

    # 4. tiled, several threads
        dir_out_tiled_n = file.path(dir_work, "out_tiled_n")
        seconds_tiled_n = fn_run_gridmetrics(c(path_chm, common_args, "/tilesize:2400,2400", paste0("/threads:", n_threads_tiled), paste0("/outdir:", dir_out_tiled_n)))

```

## Check that both did the same work

Cover and maximum height of each cell from gridmetrics against terra.

```{r, check_same_work, eval=T}

    # 1. read the gridmetrics whole-raster output
        path_gm_whole = file.path(dir_out_whole, "chm_synthetic_gridmetrics.tif")
        rast_gm = terra::rast(path_gm_whole)
        names_gm = names(rast_gm)

    # 2. pick the maximum height and cover bands
        name_max = names_gm[grepl("^elev_max$", names_gm)]
        name_cover = names_gm[grepl("cover", names_gm, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]

    # 3. compare maximum height cell by cell (terra's max excludes nothing below min_height, so compare cells with canopy)
        vals_gm_max = terra::values(rast_gm[[name_max]])[, 1]
        vals_terra_max = terra::values(rast_max)[, 1]
        is_canopy_cell = !is.na(vals_gm_max)
        max_abs_diff_max = max(abs(vals_gm_max[is_canopy_cell] - vals_terra_max[is_canopy_cell]), na.rm = TRUE)

    # 4. compare cover (terra's custom statistic 6 is cover percent)
        vals_gm_cover = terra::values(rast_gm[[name_cover]])[, 1]
        vals_terra_cover = terra::values(rast_custom[[6]])[, 1]
        max_abs_diff_cover = max(abs(vals_gm_cover - vals_terra_cover), na.rm = TRUE)

    # Validation 4 (WARN). confirm the two tools agree to within rounding
        if(max_abs_diff_max > 1e-3 || max_abs_diff_cover > 0.05){
            warning("gridmetrics and terra differ: max height ", max_abs_diff_max, ", cover ", max_abs_diff_cover)
        }

```

## Summary table

```{r, summary_table, eval=T}

    # 1. gather the timings
        dt_timing = data.frame(
            tool = c(
                "terra aggregate, mean only"
                , "terra aggregate, max only"
                , "terra aggregate, custom function (6 statistics)"
                , "gridmetrics whole raster (all bands)"
                , "gridmetrics tiled, 1 thread (all bands)"
                , paste0("gridmetrics tiled, ", n_threads_tiled, " threads (all bands)")
            )
            , seconds = c(
                time_terra_mean[["elapsed"]]
                , time_terra_max[["elapsed"]]
                , time_terra_custom[["elapsed"]]
                , seconds_whole
                , seconds_tiled_1
                , seconds_tiled_n
            )
        )

    # Validation 1 (INSPECT). confirm the timings look plausible
        print(dt_timing)
        print(paste("max height difference:", max_abs_diff_max, "cover difference:", max_abs_diff_cover))
        print(paste("pixels:", format(n_pixel_side^2, big.mark = ","), "cells:", (n_pixel_side %/% cell_pixels)^2))

```
